text:
**Date:** Saltmarsh & Rye opened to the public on 14 March 2019.
**Named person:** Marguerite Valcourt, licensing officer for the Port Ellery Harbour District, signed off the premises permit.
**Figure:** The dining room seats 62 guests, and the opening investment was reported at $1.4 million.
**Source document/event:** The report rests on the Port Ellery Harbour District licensing filing (Permit No. HD-2019-0387) and the opening-night press preview where Benedikt Auer was introduced as founding chef.
